thread:
Asha: Quick sync after INC-2026-42. We need a short project to harden rollouts: auto-rollback PoC, tenant blast-radius caps, and missing telemetry. Keep it lightweight.
Ben: Agree. I'd like clearly defined success criteria for the PoC: automated rollback fires correctly, no false positives in 1k synthetic runs, and audit events recorded.
Clara: I'll take blast-radius caps + policy. Initial idea: default sample 5%, tenant-exposure max 7%, staged increases with mandatory hold at 30%.
Diego: I'll own runtime rollback hook. Minimal API: POST /rollouts/{id}/actions with body {"action":"rollback","reason":"canary"}. Hook must emit an audit event and be idempotent.
Eli: Telemetry: add canary label to traces, track error-rate delta, KL-divergence vs baseline, and a simple synthetic traffic check every 2m.
deploy-bot: Deploy notice: staging rollout 2026-08-14T10:00 by Diego
Asha: PoC timeline proposal: policy doc 5d, runtime PoC 10d, dashboards 5d, drill 3w. Who can commit?
Clara: Policy in 5d. Will include private/VPC opt-out and compliance checklist.
Diego: Runtime PoC 10d ok. I'll put a simple cooldown of 8m after a rollback.
Ben: I'll run synthetic test harness against the rollback path and validate no more than 1% false positive across 1000 runs.
Eli: I'll sketch a Grafana board template and alert rules. Suggest alerts: error-rate up 1.5% absolute for 2m OR P95 latency increase 30% for 3m.
Asha: Decision: auto-rollback default off, per-deployment opt-in allowlist for early adopters. Add compliance gate for Private deployments.
Clara: Noted. I'll add allowlist and explicit enable flag: `auto_rollback_enabled: false` in the policy.
Diego: Draft PR: https://git/repo/runtime/pulls/200 (draft)
Ben: I'll add tests to infra and run the harness once Diego's hook is usable.
Eli: I'll provision the dashboard template as code so teams can instantiate it per deployment.
Asha: Great. I'll track actions in the incident tracker and follow up at next postmortem sync. Thanks all. :checkered_flag:
